method: Three real local generations, fictional children, public references, manual manuscript and contact-sheet review. No matched baseline or blinded evaluation.

costs.note: Provider-reported charges only. Codex subscription quota has no allocated cash price here. A connection failure before usage was returned can leave an unknown charge. This is not an incremental production-cost comparison.

issues.detail: Tilda operates a separate scooter-like sweeper, while the machine’s broom lies loose beside the box. On page 0 and in the source, the broad broom is part of the pedal-operated machine.

The collection machine has become a plain lidded wooden box, with blue fabric protruding from the top. Page 0 and the source establish a painted grinning front; the band should peek from the narrow gap between that front and the side wall.
The detached front has a different painted face: open eyes and a large pink nose, with no red border. On page 0, the same panel has closed eyes, a small nose and a prominent red border.
Nora wears a low shoe rather than boots, as she also does on page 2. The source says the wave soaks both Nora’s and Blubbert’s boots, prompting them to lift their feet together.
Ben is still wearing his backpack while using the flashlight, but the source says he removes it after Funkelflug’s wing catches in the strap, before taking out the flashlight.
The board is horizontal overhead, leaving a large open passage. On page 3 and in the source it remains slanted and wedged across the opening until Funkelflug shifts it on page 6.
The board has become a broad, rounded, tapered shape; it is a long rectangular panel on pages 3 and 5.
